name: Mask Shard #4
location: Area above Seamstress's home in Far Fields

name: Mask Shard #5

requires: At the end of a platforming challenge behind a breakable wall

name: Mask Shard #6

requires: Requires Needolin. Behind breakable wall

name: Mask Shard #7

name: Mask Shard #8
location: West Cogwork Core past enemy gauntlet

name: Mask Shard #9

name: Mask Shard #10

name: Mask Shard #11

name: Mask Shard #15

requires: Requires Clawline and Faydown Cloak. Challenge can be skipped with Silk Soar

name: Mask Shard #17
location: Brightvein
requires: Requires Silk Soar

name: Mask Shard #18
location: East Far Fields
requires: Complete the Fastest in Pharloom wish

name: Mask Shard #19
location: Reward for completing the Dark Hearts wish
requires: Complete SEEK: Awaiting the End

name: Mask Shard #20
location: Reward for completing the The Hidden Hunter wish
requires: Meet Skarrsinger Karmelita in Far Fields

name: Spool Fragment #1
location: Behind a breakable wall in a mossy area above Bone Bottom

name: Spool Fragment #2
location: Central section of the Deep Docks. Take the southwest exit from Forge Daughter's location. Descend the vertical room and take the first eastward exit to a large room with a burning floor. Hop across the platforms to first flip the lever on the far end of the room, then turn around and hop up the platforms to acquire the Spool Fragment

name: Spool Fragment #3
location: In Greymoor, above Shakra's bench. Start by wall-jumping off the vertical planks to the northeast of the Halfway Home, then travel east before pulling a lever that deploys numerous balloons. Needle-bounce off the balloons to reach the top of this large vertical area
requires: Requires the Cling Grip to enter the passage

name: Spool Fragment #4
location: Sold by Frey in Bellhart for Rosaries 270
requires: Complete the My Missing Courier wish

name: Spool Fragment #5
location: In a passage in Weavenest Atla. Ascend the east wall after taking the teleporter into the lower area. Travel west to the first Marrowmaw, jump upwards into the higher passage, navigate past the second Marrowmaw, and drop down to acquire the Fragment
requires: Requires the Needolin to open the Weavenest

name: Spool Fragment #6
location: From the Bellway station in the Slab, ascend two levels northwards into a large open room. Wall-climb off the west wall (without entering the westernmost chamber), then jump east across the tops of the cages before accessing a passage in the ceiling. Travel west along this passage, passing through the traps, and climb to the top of the outdoor section
requires: Requires the Cling Grip and a transport to the Slab

name: Spool Fragment #7
location: At the top of the Grand Gate. If approached from below, strike the scales with an upward attack to tip them

name: Spool Fragment #8
location: Central section of the Underworks. Head south from the Ventrica Station, then proceed west. Fight through the enemy gauntlet and continue west to acquire

name: Spool Fragment #9
location: Given by the Fleamaster Mooshka upon their ascent to the Grand Gate
requires: Requires 12 found Fleas and the Last Judge defeated

name: Spool Fragment #10
location: In the Whiteward, under the lift. Call up the lift using the buttons on the top, then quickly jump down the lift shaft and duck into either side passage to let the lift pass. Dive into the bottom, past where the lift normally stops, to acquire
requires: Requires White Key

name: Spool Fragment #11
location: Southeastern section of the lower Cogwork Core. Defeat or dodge a Cogwork Clapper and continue east and down to acquire. The Cogwork Clapper does not appear in Act 3

name: Spool Fragment #12
location: Lower right section of the Underworks. Head east from the Cauldron and descend down a vertical shaft to a small room with a burning floor. Break the wall on the left to access

name: Spool Fragment #13
location: Given by Sherma after completing the Balm for the Wounded wish
requires: Requires White Key

name: Spool Fragment #14
location: Sold by Jubilana for Rosaries 500
requires: Complete the The Lost Merchant wish

name: Spool Fragment #15
location: Southeastern section of the Deep Docks. First, use the Clawline to open the locked gate in the southeastern corner. Open the hatch, descend into the open cavern, then use the Clawline to reach the far wall and break open the explosive rock. This opens a platforming challenge across spikes, lava, and more explosive rocks, before finally leading to the Spool Fragment on the opposite side of the locked door
requires: Requires the Clawline and the Cling Grip. The Faydown Cloak makes acquiring this easier

name: Spool Fragment #16
location: In the High Halls at the highest point in the left vertical room
requires: Requires the Faydown Cloak and the Clawline. The challenge can be skipped with the Silk Soar

name: Spool Fragment #17
location: In the western section of the Memorium. Access the chamber by going west from the fourth floor (one floor below the Ventrica Station), then navigate around the spikes to access it. Break the vines going south to open the path leading back to the Memorium entrance
requires: Requires the Faydown Cloak and the Clawline

name: Spool Fragment #18
location: Sold by Grindle for Rosaries 680
requires: Requires the Faydown Cloak and the Cling Grip

name: Memory Locket #1
location: Hunter's March: Below the Chapel of the Beast.

name: Memory Locket #2
location: Far Fields: In Act 1 or Act 2, purchased from Mort for Rosaries 150. Alternatively (Blasted Steps): In Act 3, purchased from Grindle for Rosaries 250.
requires: Not purchasing the Memory Locket from Mort

name: Memory Locket #3
location: Greymoor: West of the Bellway.

name: Memory Locket #5
location: The Marrow: Northeast of the Bellway station.

name: Memory Locket #6

name: Memory Locket #7
location: Bellhart: Purchased from Frey for Rosaries 330.
requires: Complete SAVE: The Threadspun Town

name: Memory Locket #8
location: Blasted Steps: In the room above the first bench.
requires: Cling Grip

name: Memory Locket #9
location: Bilewater: In a hidden room northwest of the Bellway.

name: Memory Locket #10
location: Choral Chambers: Above the Grand Bellway, accessed from the eastern part of the Underworks.
requires: Defeat Phantom or Trobbio

name: Memory Locket #11
location: Underworks: Through a false ceiling above the benches by the confessional.

name: Memory Locket #12
location: Deep Docks: West of the diving bell.
requires: Clawline Defeat Forebrothers Signis & Gron

name: Memory Locket #13
location: Whispering Vaults: Below the exit to the outside area.

name: Memory Locket #14
location: Sands of Karak: In the first big room to the left.
requires: Clawline

name: Memory Locket #15
location: Greymoor: Inside of Halfway Home, above the left-hand door.
requires: Faydown Cloak

name: Memory Locket #16
location: Memorium: In the left Shellwood themed central room.
requires: Faydown Cloak

name: Memory Locket #17
location: The Slab: In the shortcut cave between the Bellway area and the upper areas.
requires: Key of Apostate Faydown Cloak

name: Memory Locket #18
location: Bilewater: Held by a corpse in a breakable cocoon just west of the hidden bench. Not visible until the cocoon is broken.
requires: Faydown Cloak

name: Memory Locket #19
location: Bellhart: In Act 3, above the Bellhome.
requires: Silk Soar

name: Memory Locket #20
location: Far Fields: In Act 3, east of Skarrsinger Karmelita.
requires: Silk Soar Defeat the black-threaded Skarrgard

name: Silk Heart 1: Defeat the Bell Beast
location: The Marrow
requires: Requires Silkspear

name: Silk Heart 2: Defeat The Unravelled
location: Whiteward
requires: Requires the Surgeon's Key

name: Silk Heart 3: Defeat Lace
location: The Cradle
requires: Requires the Threefold Melody

name: Pale Oil #1
location: In northeast Choral Chambers, accessed through the adjoining room in Whispering Vaults.
requires: Cling Grip

name: Pale Oil #2
location: Reward from Loyal Mergwin upon completing Great Taste of Pharloom.
requires: Swift Step Cling Grip Faydown Cloak

name: Pale Oil #3
location: Reward from the Flea Caravan upon completing Ecstasy of the End.
requires: Rescue all Fleas Be in Act 3

name: Craftmetal #1
location: Purchased from Pebb in Bone Bottom for Rosaries 60. Alternatively: In Act 3, purchased from Grindle in the Blasted Steps for Rosaries 120.
requires: Faydown Cloak

name: Craftmetal #2
location: Found by exploding a tunnel of rock in the northeast area of the Marrow, in the large room west of the entrance to Hunter's March.

name: Craftmetal #3
location: Found in a chest behind the locked door in the Deep Docks. It is located at the southwest corner of the bottom-most room that connects to the Far Fields.

name: Craftmetal #4
location: Found in the Blasted Steps in a hidden area in the room before the Last Judge, by falling down a hole in the middle of the room.

name: Craftmetal #5
location: Purchased from Jubilana in Songclave for Rosaries 180.
requires: Complete the The Lost Merchant wish

name: Craftmetal #6
location: Found behind a breakable ceiling in Wisp Thicket.
requires: Faydown Cloak

name: Craftmetal #7
location: Found at the end of a tunnel in the eastern Underworks, directly south of where the Clawline can be found.

name: Craftmetal #8
location: Found at the far eastern end of Pale Lake in the Putrified Ducts.

name: The Lost Fleas
location: Bone Bottom Wishwall / The Marrow NPC Mooshka of the Flea Caravan
description: Seek fleas across the lands of Pharloom and guide them to the Flea Caravan.

name: Pinmaster's Oil
location: Bellhart NPC Pinmaster Plinney
description: Retrieve Pale Oil from the Citadel.
quote: "Lost within that fortress above, the fabled oil of my profession... Such sharpness one could achieve..."

name: My Missing Courier
location: Bellhart Wishwall Frey of Bellhart
reward: Opens additional inventory to purchase from Frey. Prerequisite for My Missing Brother
description: Search for traces of the courier, Tipp, and track his location. Tipp was last seen in lower Shellwood.

name: My Missing Brother
location: Bellhart Wishwall Tipp of Bellhart
description: Search for traces of the courier, Pill, and track his location. Pill was last seen in lower Greymoor.

name: Balm for the Wounded
location: Songclave Wishwall Sherma of Songclave
reward: Spool Fragment Prerequisite for Silk and Soul
description: Search for traces of the pilgrim, Sherma, and track his location. Sherma was travelling to the Citadel's Whiteward.

name: The Wandering Merchant
location: Songclave Wishwall Residents of Songclave
reward: Jubilana sets up shop in Songclave. Prerequisite for The Lost Merchant
description: Search for traces of the merchant, Jubilana, and track her location. Jubilana was last seen in the lower Choral Chambers.

name: The Lost Merchant
location: Songclave Wishwall Residents of Songclave
reward: Opens additional inventory to purchase from Jubilana.
description: Search for traces of the merchant, Jubilana, and track her location. Jubilana was last seen near the Citadel's Memorium.

name: Rite of Rebirth
location: Shellwood NPC Greyroot
description: Bind the Twisted Bud.
quote: "White shell. Red cloak. Bug strong and old. The time of birth is near. Aid now the final rite."

name: Infestation Operation
location: Greymoor NPC Yarnaby
description: Acquire Steel Spines from Crull and Benjin in Sinner's Road so Yarnaby can remove the parasite.
quote: "The great Yarnaby can rid you of those nasty "roots", but to crack your stiff shell my mighty Extricator needs an upgrade!"

name: Trail's End
location: Bellhart Wishwall Shakra
reward: Throwing Ring Trail's End Prerequisite for Silk and Soul
description: Search for Shakra and her master in Bilewater. Shakra can be tracked by her trail of rings.

name: Final Audience
location: Songclave Wishwall Second Sentinel
description: Track the Second Sentinel by their markers left near Songclave.

name: Silk and Soul
location: Bellhart Wishwall / Songclave NPC Caretaker of Songclave
reward: Unlocks the DESTROY: Soul Snare objective.
description: Acquire the necessary components to build a powerful trap. Maiden's Soul Hermit's Soul Seeker's Soul Snare Setter

name: Fatal Resolve
location: Bellhart Wishwall / Blasted Steps Note Pinstress of Blasted Steps
description: Find Pinstress on the stormward side of Mount Fay and defeat her in battle.

name: Pain, Anguish and Misery
location: Songclave Wishwall The Tormented One
description: Return to the Citadel's Stage, beside the Whispering Vaults.

name: Hero's Call
location: Bellhart Wishwall Residents of Bellhart
description: Seek out the distressed bug near the Blasted Steps Bellway.

name: Ecstasy of the End
location: Bellhart Wishwall / Fleatopia NPC Mooshka of Fleatopia
description: Achieve the high score in all Flea Games and become the Grand Champion. Juggle Dodge Bounce

name: Berry Picking
location: Bone Bottom Wishwall / Mosshome NPC Druid of Mosshome
description: Collect Mossberries from the moss-covered areas of Pharloom's lowlands.

name: Rite of the Pollip
location: Shellwood NPC Greyroot
description: Collect Pollip Hearts from the purple flowers of Shellwood.
quote: "The time of birth approaches. Pollip Hearts are needed. Bring them, bug, and power will be shared."

name: Silver Bells
location: Bellhart Wishwall Residents of Bellhart
description: Collect Silver Bells in the bellvein tunnels above and below Bellhart.

name: Alchemist's Assistant
location: Wormways NPC Alchemist Zylotol
description: Collect Plasmium from Plasmium buds in the lower Wormways. Plasmium can be extracted from buds using a fully charged stab from the Needle Phial tool.
quote: "Perhaps, like myself, you have been bewitched by the Plasmium's beautiful glow? Then join me, you must! A new assistant is needed. Together we shall unlock the secrets of this wondrous substance!"

name: Great Taste of Pharloom
location: Choral Chambers NPC Loyal Mergwin
description: Collect rare delicacies of Pharloom. Mossberry Stew Vintage Nectar Courier's Rasher Crustnut Pickled Muckmaggot
quote: "If your idle claws need work, put them to service for our exalted Great Gourmand! I must remain by my master, so you will need to leave the Citadel and gather the ingredients for their meal in my stead!"

name: Advanced Alchemy
location: Wormways NPC Alchemist Zylotol
description: Collect Plasmified Blood from infected creatures in the Wormways. Plasmified Blood can be extracted with a fully charged stab from the Needle Phial tool.
quote: "Assistant... to learn more of Plasmium's wonders... I know what we must do..."

name: Garb of the Pilgrims
location: Bone Bottom Wishwall Residents of Bone Bottom
description: Hunt haunted pilgrims of Pharloom and collect Pilgrim Shawls from their bodies.

name: Flexile Spines
location: Far Fields NPC Seamstress
reward: Drifter's Cloak Prerequisite for Silk and Soul
description: Hunt Hokers in the Far Fields and collect Spine Cores.
quote: "If you're planning to ascend from these low fields, you'll be needing some lift, and I'm just the bug to help."

name: Volatile Flintbeetles
location: Bone Bottom Wishwall Residents of Bone Bottom
description: Track down Flintbeetles in the Marrow and defeat them to collect Flintgems. Flintbeetles can be tracked by their stone-sheddings and their aromatic dung.

name: Crawbug Clearing
location: Bellhart Wishwall / Halfway Home NPC Creige of the Halfway Home
reward: Crafting Kit Prerequisite for Silk and Soul
description: Hunt Crawbugs in Greymoor and collect their Ragpelt.

name: Roach Guts
location: Sinner's Road NPCs Crull and Benjin
description: Hunt the Muckroaches of Sinner's Road and collect Roach Guts from their bodies.
quote: "How 'bout you put that poker to good use then, missy? Go poach some of them roaches and get us some tasty guts? There'd be fair trade waitin' for yer!"

name: Fine Pins
location: Songclave Wishwall Residents of Songclave
description: Hunt pin-wielding choirbugs of the Citadel and collect Fine Pins.

name: Cloaks of the Choir
location: Songclave Wishwall Residents of Songclave
description: Hunt cloaked choirbugs of the Citadel and collect Choir Cloaks from their bodies.

name: Broodfeast
location: Putrified Ducts NPC Huntress
description: Use tools to acquire organs of various types so Huntress may feed her brood. Seared Organ Shredded Organ Skewered Organ
quote: "Would you gift organs for my brood, sssppiidderr? Upon first waking my children will be consumed with craving."

name: Runtfeast
location: Putrified Ducts NPC Runt
description: Use tools to acquire organs of various types so Runt may feed. Seared Organ Shredded Organ Skewered Organ
quote: "Us needssss meatsss... hunter... finds... bringsss... So us'sss small does grow like siblingssss..."

name: Dark Hearts
location: Bellhart Wishwall Residents of Bellhart
description: Destroy Void Masses throughout Pharloom.

name: The Terrible Tyrant
location: Bone Bottom Wishwall Residents of Bone Bottom
description: Hunt a Skull Tyrant of the Marrow.

name: Savage Beastfly
location: Bellhart Wishwall Residents of Bellhart
description: Track down the Savage Beastfly in the Far Fields and defeat it. The Beastfly can be tracked by its shell sheddings and claw marks.

name: The Wailing Mother
location: Songclave Wishwall Residents of Songclave
description: Track down the wailing creature in the Slab and slay it. The creature can be tracked by its slime trail.

name: The Hidden Hunter
location: Bellhart Wishwall Gilly of Far Fields
description: Track the one who stole Gilly's keepsake near the Bellshrine between Deep Docks and Far Fields.

name: Bone Bottom Repairs
location: Bone Bottom Wishwall Flick of Bone Bottom
reward: Prerequisite for A Lifesaving Bridge Prerequisite for Silk and Soul
description: Donate shell shards to aid repairs around Bone Bottom.

name: A Lifesaving Bridge
location: Bone Bottom Wishwall Flick of Bone Bottom
reward: A destructible bridge is constructed over the hole that leads to Moss Grotto. Prerequisite for An Icon of Hope Prerequisite for Silk and Soul
description: Donate shell shards to aid the building of a bridge.

name: Restoration of Bellhart
location: Bellhart Wishwall Pavo of Bellhart
reward: Prerequisite for Bellhart's Glory Prerequisite for Silk and Soul
description: Donate rosaries to aid the rebuilding of Bellhart.

name: An Icon of Hope
location: Bone Bottom Wishwall Flick of Bone Bottom
reward: A destructible statue of Flick is erected in Bone Bottom. Hornet Statuette
description: Donate shell shards to aid the construction of an icon of hope.

name: Bellhart's Glory
location: Bellhart Wishwall Pavo of Bellhart
reward: Prerequisite for the Bellhome Key Prerequisite for Silk and Soul
description: Donate rosaries to aid the rebuilding of Bellhart.

name: Building Up Songclave
location: Songclave Wishwall Caretaker of Songclave
reward: Prerequisite for Strengthening Songclave Prerequisite for Silk and Soul
description: Donate rosaries to aid the growing Songclave.

name: Strengthening Songclave
location: Songclave Wishwall Caretaker of Songclave
reward: Prerequisite for The Lost Merchant Prerequisite for Silk and Soul
description: Donate rosaries to aid the Songclave's residents.

name: Bone Bottom Supplies
location: Bellhart NPCs Couriers Tipp & Pill
description: Deliver supplies to the fixer Flick in Bone Bottom.
quote: "Goods for the camp at base, where pilgrims' journey starts. We muchly hope this delivering goes well!"

name: Pilgrim's Rest Supplies
location: Bellhart NPCs Couriers Tipp & Pill
description: Deliver supplies to Mort in Pilgrim's Rest.
quote: "Supplies for the rest-stop in the fields. We is used to like this delivering, when we was young and muchly brave."

name: Queen's Egg
location: Bellhart NPCs Couriers Tipp & Pill
reward: Rosaries 260 (Act 2) Rosaries 290 (Act 3) Styx expands his nest, allowing for the generation of more Silkeaters.
description: Deliver the Queen's Egg to Styx of Sinner's Road.
quote: "We is got requested times a'many for this, a queeny egg of those eaters of Silk. Wish from big, sticky creature, near many roaches caged. Wants it muchly!"

name: Songclave Supplies
location: Bellhart NPCs Couriers Tipp & Pill
description: Deliver supplies to the Caretaker in Songclave.
quote: "Good-goods for the pilgrims up high! Thems brave ones, settled up on that big-big Citadel. These deliverings they will muchly need, miss courier. Carry them safe-safe, for us!"

name: Fleatopia Supplies
location: Bellhart NPCs Couriers Tipp & Pill
description: Deliver supplies to the Fleamaster Mooshka in Fleatopia.
quote: "Those good-goods, all packed fresh for the clever fleas. Take thems up for us, miss courier. Maybe new friends you might be making with your service? Yes-yes?"

name: Liquid Lacquer
location: Bellhart NPCs Couriers Tipp & Pill
description: Deliver Liquid Lacquer to the Mask Maker upon Mount Fay.
quote: "A delivery deadly, dangerous, fiercably cold, for old bug up there that does need it much-much! Serves us all he does, so we serve back. And great test for you, miss courier! Most challenging-challenge this. The lacquer to bring is sloshy-slosh. A hard carry even for the best."

name: Survivor's Camp Supplies
location: Bellhart NPCs Couriers Tipp & Pill
reward: Rosaries 180 Replaces Bone Bottom Supplies and Pilgrim's Rest Supplies
description: Deliver supplies to Flick at the Survivors' Camp.
quote: "A new destination this-this! And desperate these supplies are asked. Deliverings for them-them escaped from the crumbled camp beside the bone, those few still living. Hurting and hungry, those few must be."

name: LEARN: Bugs of Pharloom
location: Halfway Home NPC Nuu
description: Defeat the many creatures of Pharloom and fill out the Hunter's Journal.
quote: "Would you help Nuu? Could you take her scroll, and fill its pages with the learnings of your cuts?"

name: SPRINT: Fastest in Pharloom
location: Bellhart Wishwall / Far Fields NPC Sprintmaster Swift
reward: First Race: Rosary Necklace Second Race: Beast Shard Third Race: Mask Shard
description: Race Sprintmaster Swift to discover Pharloom's fastest bug.

name: WITNESS: Passing of the Age
location: Putrified Ducts Riddle Tablet The Herald
description: Under chapel fallen to the monarch's might, Over camp collapsed to the black thread plight, Scorched field on edge, shells black and burned, Up towers spinning, near the surgeon spurned, Cage of one who raged against the silken lie, Fell heart of frost, who soars on high, Past cradle's peak, last test of fitness, That the age may pass, this shroom its witness.
quote: "We speak the wish of the Master Herald, he who signs an Age's end."

name: STEEL: A Vassal Lost
location: Blasted Steps NPC Steel Seer Zi
description: Investigate the resting sites marked by Steel Seer Zi to uncover the location of her vassal.
quote: "Creature, higher... It has been sent... by Masters served... to retrieve Zi's vassal lost?"

name: Silkspear
description: Attack by throwing the needle forward. Silk will be expended.

name: Thread Storm
description: Attack by whipping a storm of Silk around oneself.

name: Cross Stitch
description: Bind Silk around the needle to deflect enemy attacks and instantly strike back.

name: Sharpdart
description: Pierce through enemies in a blur of blade and Silk.

name: Rune Rage
description: Weave runes of blazing Silk upon enemies.

name: Pale Nails
description: Spin lethal talons from thread that seek out enemies.

name: Swift Step
description: Sprint at blinding speed, beyond one's natural limits. Chase down prey and leap great distances.

name: Cling Grip
description: Cling to sheer surfaces and leap to rapidly scale heights.

name: Needolin
description: Play ancient melodies by stringing Silk along the needle. Silk will be expended. Strike enemies to replenish Silk.

name: Clawline
description: Fling the needle as a harpoon and launch forcefully towards it. Silk will be expended. Strike enemies to replenish Silk.

name: Silk Soar
description: Fling the needle upwards and launch to tremendous heights. Silk will be expended. Strike enemies to replenish Silk.

name: Sylphsong
description: Eva's soul and strength reside within. Silk will regenerate when resting at a bench.

name: Conductor's Melody
description: One part of the Threefold Melody, entrusted to the Conductors.

name: Architect's Melody
description: One part of the Threefold Melody, entrusted to the industrious Architects.

name: Vaultkeeper's Melody
description: One part of the Threefold Melody, entrusted to the secretive Vaultkeepers.

name: Beastling Call
description: Mimic the song of the Bell Beast. Summon the Beastlings and return together to their mother.

name: Elegy of the Deep
description: Draw out memories of Pharloom's forgotten past.

name: Bind
description: Attack enemies to replenish Silk. Press BIND to bind your wounds.

name: Silk Heart
description: Regained the power to regenerate Silk within one's shell.

name: Needle Strike
description: Charge power in the needle, then release as a deadly attack.

name: Drifter's Cloak
description: Flare the cloak to ride strong winds or glide gracefully.

name: Faydown Cloak
description: Fabled feather down, layered within the cloak. Leap again while airborne. Soar above foes. Reach new heights. Strike from above.

name: Farsight
description: Completion quantities will be displayed in Menus.

name: Everbloom
description: Fragile flower taken from a deep and distant memory. Its pale light wards against the void.
